sara.p: Hey folks — prepping for my leave, quick q: what's the process to request a phased return and how does payroll top-up work? Also is there a childcare reimbursement I should apply for? thanks! :wave:
people-ops: Hi @sara.p — congrats! :tada: Short version: submit the parental leave request form, choose the phased return option, and opt into the 'payroll top-up' box on the form. We'll confirm eligibility within 3 business days.
people-ops: Link: https://redwood.intra/hr/forms/parental-leave
people-ops: Required docs: doctor/placement letter + expected return date. If you want a phased return, include proposed hours per week and preferred duration.
sara.p: Is the payroll top-up automatic? How much and for how long?
people-ops: Top-up is not automatic — please tick the checkbox on the form. Typical policy: up to 12 weeks at 50% salary top-up for primary caregivers (subject to >=6 months employment). Payroll will process once we approve.
tony.mgr: @sara.p if you share your rough handover plan we can slot coverage. Also flagging on-call rotations — can you coordinate handing off pager to @javier.hr for the first 2 weeks?
sara.p: Yep I'll upload a handover doc today. Quick Q on childcare reimbursement: do receipts need to be pre-approved or can I claim after we return?
people-ops: Childcare rebate = up to $500/month for 6 months for folks returning from leave. For daycare contracts over $1000/mo we ask for pre-approval. Otherwise submit receipts after service and include the claim id from the leave form.
people-ops: Claim submission steps:
```
1) Fill parental-leave form
2) Select 'childcare rebate' and submit proposed return date
3) Receive claim id (within 48h)
4) Email receipts + claim id to payroll@redwood.com
```
emily: Any paperwork for benefits continuation? I think @people-ops-bot pushed a reminder earlier.
people-ops-bot: reminder: Benefits continuity form must be completed within 30 days of leave start to avoid insurance gaps. Link: https://redwood.intra/hr/benefits/continuity
people-ops: We'll run you through COBRA/region-specific options if needed; ping us and we'll set a 15-min call to walk through details.
sara.p: Amazing — thanks everyone. I'll submit the form today and add the handover doc. :heart:
tony.mgr: thanks, we got you. :thumbsup:
